messages:
Sam (People Ops): Hey everyone 3 following up from today's all-hands. Threading the leftover leveling/comp/benefits Qs we didn't get to. I'll answer what I can and tag folks for details.

Riley (Eng): Quick practical q: if I'm promoted and approval clears right before payroll cutoff, will the pay change land in that run or the next? Any chance of backdating?

Sam (People Ops): If approval is before payroll cutoff we'll try to include it in that run; otherwise it goes to the next. Backdating to the start of the review period is allowed only if the manager requests it within 30 days of our approval timestamp and Finance signs off. Exceptions >30 days need Exec approval.

Ben (Manager): Which timestamp starts the 30-day clock 5 manager submission or People Ops finalization?

Sam (People Ops): The People Ops finalization timestamp in the HR system is the official start. That's what payroll and retro rules reference.

Clara (Finance): Adding: bonus treatment depends on the bonus declaration date. Promotions approved before that date count at the new level; after that we prorate by days-at-level. Manual pay fixes may take up to two payroll cycles to appear.

Riley (Eng): Mid-search bump question: if a req's level is changed while interviews are in flight, should Recruiting update candidates immediately?

Sam (People Ops): Yes 5 update the req band right away, inform active candidates, and tag Hiring Manager + Finance. For unsigned offers we can reissue at the new band with Finance approval. Signed offers stay as-is unless an exception is approved.

Riley (Eng): Parental leave: if someone switches to a reduced-hours arrangement, who files the pay change?

Sam (People Ops): Managers submit a temporary FTE change in the HR portal (select "reduced hours"). Benefits carry per the parental policy. If payroll issues appear, tag @HR-Bot-payroll and we'll triage. Link: https://intranet.redwood.com/benefits/parental

Ava (CEO): Leadership ask: People Ops, please publish a single-page "Promo & Pay FAQ" (bullet timeline, retro window, appeals steps, manager checklist). Keep it short and pin it to the channel.

Sam (People Ops): Will do. I'll draft the one-pager and a 2-point manager checklist by Wednesday and post it here.

HR-Bot: Reminder: comp packets due to #people-ops by 4/18 17:00 UTC.

Riley (Eng): Thanks 5 this clears up our main questions.

Sam (People Ops): Thanks all. If you have a confidential case, DM me and include "private appeal". Keeping this thread pinned for the week.
